library_preparation_preflight.summary: Netty Transport Alpha2 supports meaningful loopback NIO client/server coverage using its normal transitive dependencies; it requires no external service, Docker image, or environment property. The existing scaffold already declares the optional netty-codec-http module used by its HTTP tests.
risks: The existing tests use Alpha1 HTTP APIs removed or renamed in Alpha2, so they require source migration rather than additional setup.
HTTP coverage depends on the scaffold's existing io.netty:netty-codec-http dependency because it is not transitively provided by netty-transport.
